While at a base, 
its mysterious spores slow the rate at which the SAN value of allies at the base decreases by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue2}%</>.

Sometimes drops <itemName id=|Mushroom| style=|Status_Keyword|/> or <itemName id=|CaveMushroom| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
